conditions.runtime: Curated JEM JEI catalog and shared JEM Economy category admission; player acceptance pending

change.summary: Lock each known JEI item registry ID to one reviewed leaf category and stop startup-time semantic reassignment.

modifiers.before: Every JEI startup reclassified all live stacks from ordered class, tag, name, recipe and block-state heuristics, so a pack or rule change could move earlier approved items.
modifiers.after: One checked-in schema-versioned manifest assigns every known registry ID to one leaf. Runtime performs direct ID lookup, parent categories aggregate leaves, and unknown IDs fail visibly into OTHER without changing accepted assignments.

modifiers.before: No durable assignment artifact or repeatable coverage check existed.
modifiers.after: The offline Registry Atlas generator preserves every existing manifest assignment, proposes only unknown IDs, and validates duplicate IDs, parent targets and schema completeness.

modifiers.before: The curated search EditBox was both a native screen renderable and a manually rendered overlay child, so the screen could continue rendering it after standard JEI mode was selected.
modifiers.after: The curated overlay exclusively owns rendering and input for its search EditBox. Standard JEI mode makes it invisible and inactive and clears focus without clearing either saved search query.

rationale.purpose: Prevent category drift when the user adds categories or subcategories and remove repeated semantic work from JEI startup.
rationale.decision_source: User request on 2026-11-21 plus the accepted JEI assignments recorded in CHANGELOG.md

introduced.summary: Create the durable exact JEI assignment owner and shared runtime adapter.

history.summary: Correct the exact Handcrafted cushion, sheet, desk and counter families to Furniture before delivery and map all new weapon leaves back to WEAPONS through the legacy three-argument classifier overload.
Remove the curated search EditBox from the native screen renderable list so standard JEI cannot display or focus it after a mode switch.
Lock 17,160 known item IDs to one leaf and preserve future reviewed assignments.

relations: JEMCompat remains the only category owner for JEI and Economy.
JEI remains the recipe and visible ItemStack variant owner.
Unknown future registry IDs remain visible under OTHER until reviewed.
notes: The initial manifest preserves the user's recorded category corrections and splits only weapon assignments into the three weapon leaves.
unresolved: Runtime category layout and startup timing remain in testing until player acceptance.
